# Add this to ~/.claude/settings.json (merge into an existing "hooks" block).
# Then run `claude` inside a `roost` window and its badge tracks its state.
# Outside roost these hooks are silent no-ops.
# "matcher": "permission_prompt" matters — an unmatched Notification hook also
# fires for idle_prompt/auth_success, which would paint a finished agent red.
# PostToolUse is what clears the red: no hook fires when you answer a permission
# dialog, so without it the window stays blocked until the whole turn ends.
# --stop-hook on the Stop entry is what powers `roost read`: it lets the hook
# read Stop's JSON payload, whose last_assistant_message field carries the
# turn's reply. Leave it off and everything still badges correctly — `roost
# read` just falls back to scraping the pane's screen, and tells you it did.
{
  "hooks": {
    "UserPromptSubmit": [
      { "hooks": [ { "type": "command", "command": "@@ROOST_HOME@@/scripts/roost-agent-state working" } ] }
    ],
    "Notification": [
      { "matcher": "permission_prompt",
        "hooks": [ { "type": "command", "command": "@@ROOST_HOME@@/scripts/roost-agent-state blocked" } ] }
    ],
    "PostToolUse": [
      { "hooks": [ { "type": "command", "command": "@@ROOST_HOME@@/scripts/roost-agent-state working" } ] }
    ],
    "Stop": [
      { "hooks": [ { "type": "command", "command": "@@ROOST_HOME@@/scripts/roost-agent-state done --stop-hook" } ] }
    ]
  }
}
